executionSlices.title: First-class execution slices and evidence
executionSlices.objective: Deliver a backward-compatible, inspectable execution-slice overlay with honest evidence closure.
executionSlices.hypothesis: SpecForge can add a bounded operational layer without duplicating the canonical hierarchy or turning incidental fixes into thematic WIP.

entryCriteria.description: The canonical slice requirements and boundaries are recorded.

included: CLI, API, and read-only UI inspection

work.description: Implement execution slice types and strict loading.
Implement lifecycle, reference, WIP, blocker, and evidence validation.
Expose and document slices through diagnostics and the UI.

exitCriteria.description: Version 0.1 and valid version 0.2 overlays load successfully.
Invalid lifecycle and evidence state produces deterministic findings.
The CLI, API, and UI expose execution slices without adding canonical nodes.

requiredEvidence.description: Core tests cover valid, malformed, active, blocked, validated, and disproved slices.
The UI production build succeeds with the slice screen.
SpecForge parse, compose, and validate pass for this repository.

observedEvidence.description: All 110 core tests pass, including slice loader, lifecycle, evidence, WIP, and selector coverage.
The Vite production build completes with the execution slice screen.
Repository parse, compose, and validation complete with zero diagnostics and zero findings.
observedEvidence.command: npm run parse && npm run compose && npm run validate

killCriteria: The model requires copying canonical acceptance criteria into slices.

decisions.decision: Defer bundles until their independent semantics are proven.
decisions.reason: An ordered or tagged slice group is sufficient for current needs.

decisions.decision: Allow explicitly tagged incidental maintenance outside the active slice.
decisions.reason: Small unrelated fixes should not force the thematic slice into blocked state.

executionSlices.nextAction: Review the implementation and choose the next execution slice.

executionSlices.title: Consumer upgrade to slice-capable overlay v0.2
executionSlices.objective: Upgrade an existing untouched SpecForge v0.1 consumer to overlay and local CLI v0.2 in one safe, idempotent bootstrap pass.
executionSlices.hypothesis: Managed artifact identity and additive overlay migration can make upgrades automatic without overwriting consumer customizations.

entryCriteria.description: Overlay v0.2 loading and slice validation are already implemented.
The current v0.1 bootstrap and manifest behavior is characterized.

included: Additive local overlay v0.1 to v0.2 migration
Verified legacy CLI upgrade and partial repair
Customized artifact conflict preservation and reporting
Migration tests and consumer workflow documentation
excluded: Interactive force replacement of customized tooling

work.description: Implement safe overlay migration and bootstrap action semantics.
Implement hashed managed CLI upgrades, detection, and conflict handling.
Prove upgrade, idempotency, partial repair, customization preservation, and local slice support.

exitCriteria.description: An untouched v0.1 consumer becomes overlay and CLI v0.2 in one load.
A second load is idempotent and a customized runtime is preserved.
The upgraded consumer CLI composes and validates execution slices.

requiredEvidence.description: Automated migration tests cover success, idempotency, partial repair, and customization conflict.
A bootstrapped consumer CLI reports version 0.2 and processes executionSlices.
Full tests, UI build, parse, compose, and validate pass.

observedEvidence.description: Migration regression tests prove additive overlay conversion, verified CLI upgrade, idempotency, partial repair, unsupported-overlay reporting, and customized-runtime preservation.
The upgraded repository-local CLI reports v0.2, composes executionSlices, and emits V-203 for two active thematic slices.
All 114 tests and the UI production build pass; repository parse and compose have zero diagnostics and validate has zero findings.
observedEvidence.command: npm test; npm --prefix ui run build; npm run parse; npm run compose; npm run validate

killCriteria: Safe upgrade requires overwriting unverified consumer modifications.
Overlay entry preservation cannot be made deterministic.

decisions.decision: Upgrade automatically only when managed identity is verified.
decisions.reason: Consumer customizations have higher priority than automatic version convergence.

executionSlices.nextAction: Review the validated consumer upgrade and select the next execution slice.

executionSlices.title: Bookmarkable workspace URL state
executionSlices.objective: Make local workspace context recoverable and bookmarkable through the browser URL.
executionSlices.hypothesis: A small, pure URL-state contract can restore repository, tab, and selection without changing the repository API.

entryCriteria.description: The existing workspace reducer and browser shell have stable repository, screen, and selection state.

work.description: Implement the URL-state module and synchronize it with workspace loading and navigation.
Add URL-state regression coverage and run the UI build, full tests, parse, compose, and validate checks.

exitCriteria.description: A URL with a repository path restores the requested tab and selected item safely.
The repository checks and UI production build pass with the feature enabled.

requiredEvidence.description: Automated tests cover URL parsing, serialization, tab fallback, and selection restoration.
Full repository tests, UI build, parse, compose, and validate checks succeed.

observedEvidence.description: The UI-state suite covers encoded Windows paths, stable tab mappings, query preservation, and restored selection.
The full suite, UI production build, and SpecForge repository checks pass after URL-state integration.
observedEvidence.command: npm test; npm --prefix ui run build; npm run parse; npm run compose; npm run validate

killCriteria: Repository loading requires a server-side bookmark registry.
Browser history cannot preserve a coherent workspace state.

decisions.decision: Use query parameters for repository, tab, and item state.
decisions.reason: The URL is directly bookmarkable and was chosen explicitly for this workspace flow.

executionSlices.nextAction: Use a bookmark URL to resume a local workspace.
